## Hypothesis

The monotone increase in OOS exp/tr observed from 0DTE to 2DTE for the vwap_continuation signal (ITM-2, -8%/+30%) continues to 3DTE and 4DTE, driven by lower theta decay on entry premium allowing more of the directional move to capture.

## Mechanism

Same as WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE: buy the SAME directional signal (vwap_continuation) at longer DTE (3 and 4 day weekly) instead of 0DTE; same strike (ITM-2) + same exit (-8%/+30%); isolates the DTE variable. We will use the pending OP-16 backfill (options_3dte/4dte) to compute OOS exp/tr for 3DTE and 4DTE.
